rationale: AfD winning German state government shifts EU political dynamics; Ukraine war continuing into winter maintains Black Sea security concerns and energy uncertainty for Romania. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: German far-right set for big win in eastern state, projections show
top_events.label: AfD wins first German state since WWII
top_events.summary: Far-right party projected to win over 44% in Saxony-Anhalt. First state government since 1945 raises concerns about EU cohesion and support for eastern members facing security threats.

top_events.title: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
top_events.label: Ukraine war to continue into winter
top_events.summary: No breakthrough after US envoy talks. War extending into winter maintains Black Sea security concerns and refugee pressure on Romania's northern border.

top_events.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
top_events.label: Iran threatens escalation after US strikes
top_events.summary: Tehran warns of stronger retaliation following US strikes on oil tankers. Continued Middle East tension sustains elevated fuel prices affecting Romanian transport and living costs.

short_summary: US envoys visit Moscow Kyiv for peace talks

most_significant_event.label: US envoys visit Moscow Kyiv for peace talks
most_significant_event.summary: Trump's peace envoys travel to Moscow and Kyiv this weekend to restart stalled negotiations, potentially affecting regional security dynamics near Romania.
